data.action: 倚在白玉池壁，一手稳住池沿酒杯，另一手轻拨水面桃花瓣。
data.description: 岁府汤室的玉池水汽氤氲，青瓷香炉吐着袅袅白烟。令倚着白玉池壁，全裸的身子浸在温水中，湿漉漉的蓝发贴着光裸的脊背垂入池面，指尖有一搭没一搭地拨弄着水面漂浮的桃花瓣。她眯起蓝瞳，声音懒洋洋的——「水温正好，雾气也正好……博士，要下来一起泡一会儿吗？」
data.lighting: warm candlelight through carved lattice, incense smoke, glistening jade pool reflections
data.promptProse: Adult Ling rests against the jade bath wall, steadying the wine cup on the rim with one hand and moving a floating peach petal with the other. Candlelight through the carved lattice glimmers on the water; incense smoke rises beside the celadon burner.
data.title: 令 · 玉池汤沐
data.animaCaption: One hand steadies the cup on the rim while the other moves a floating petal.
